approval_ref: The active goal requires a managed advanced-model reference implementation on the same locally selected evidence snapshot without deleting existing behavior.
notes: Add a zero-call clone action that reuses one frozen Reference evaluation only after the active model profile changes.
Preserve project, run, snapshot, ordered normalized questions and question-set hash while assigning a new task and frozen profile; never rewrite the source task.
Compare only same-project tasks with identical run, snapshot and complete question identity. Reject every mismatch before any model dispatch.

Show saved public answers, missing facts, calculations, citations, review status, safe failure or pending state, but classify only changed, unchanged or pending and never claim correctness, precedence or a preferred model.
Keep clone and comparison local, bounded, deterministic, text-safe and independent from model execution. No live or paid call is permitted.

Implemented project-first isolation, exact per-question compatibility checks, stable public-outcome hashes, explicit no-correctness policy, safe failure and pending comparisons, frozen-profile display, and browser controls that reuse the existing one-question execution path.

Validation completed with 29 focused backend/browser tests, 24 localization tests, 23 governance/devtools tests, and the complete 1,511-test Python suite. Node syntax checks, requirement/schema sync, context packing and the change ledger also passed; no external model call was made.
title: Clone and compare same-snapshot Reference model evaluations
objective: Create a local, deterministic path to clone one frozen Reference question set for another active model and compare the resulting same-snapshot outcomes without a management-time model call or engineering correctness claim.
